svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI ANTI-VENDOR LOCK-IN & 4-LAYER OPEN-STANDARDS PORTABILITY
Switch Cloud/Open-Weight Models in 2.5 Days with 0% App Rewrite via 4 Open Standards
40 AI Apps / 120 Tools / 50M Chunks: Tier 1 Proprietary SDK Lock-In (112 Days, $480K) vs. Tier 4 4-Layer Portability (2.5 Days, $18K)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: Stateful Lock-In & Dumb Wrappers
1. Vendor-Hosted Stateful Threads & Closed Vector Stores (Tier 1):
• Hardcoding vendor `Assistants/Threads/Runs` APIs & non-exportable
vector stores forces a 112-day, 92% code rewrite across 40 apps!
2. Lowest-Common-Denominator String Wrapper (Tier 2):
• Stripping all calls to raw text loses 38% of native frontier features
(drops 90% prompt caching discounts, strict JSON & reasoning effort)
3. Proprietary Vendor Plugin / Tool Schemas:
• Rewriting 120 tool definitions for every cloud provider SDK
Production Failure Impact (40 Apps / 120 Tools / 50M Chunks):
• Provider Migration Lead Time: 112 Days (16 Weeks) in Tier 1
• App Code Rewrite: 92.0% (Tier 1) | Lost Features: 38.0% (Tier 2)
• Total Exit & Re-Indexing Cost: $480,000
🏆 Tier 4: 4-Layer Open-Standards Portability Stack
1. Layer 1 (State & Gateway): Client-Owned Postgres State + AI Gateway:
• Own conversation state in Postgres; Gateway translates `cache_control`
& `reasoning_effort` at edge (retains 99.0% native frontier features!)
2. Layer 2 & 3 (Tools & Data): MCP Protocol + Iceberg Canonical Chunks:
• 120 tools written once as MCP Servers; 50M parsed chunks stored in
Apache Iceberg/Parquet with portable open-weight embeddings (`BGE-M3`)
3. Layer 4 (Prompts & Observability): DSPy + OpenTelemetry GenAI:
• Auto-recompiles prompts against 500-case eval suite in 2.5 days
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Provider Switch Time: 2.5 Days (-109.5 days vs. Tier 1)
• App Code Rewrite: 0.0% | Native Feature Retention: 99.0%
• Total Migration Cost: $18,000 (-96.3% savings vs. Tier 1)
